current_milestone.title: V1.6 engineering release candidate ready for owner acceptance
current_milestone.outcome: Quick and extended Golden Regression plus the complete local backend/frontend/n8n/container engineering gate passed. RELEASE_FREEZE remains in progress only for owner manual acceptance; no V1.6 public GitHub Actions claim is made yet.

commands.summary: Quick Golden Regression produced trusted success in CN/US/HK; extended nine-company regression produced six trusted successes and three explicit safe abstentions with no invented report.

commands.command: uv lock --check; ruff format/check; mypy --strict; pytest -q; validate_contracts.py; frontend typecheck/lint/test/build/E2E; n8n generation/test/lint
commands.summary: Full non-container gate passed: 199 pytest tests, strict mypy over 98 source files, contract preservation, 4 frontend unit tests, 3 mocked E2E, 3 live-backend E2E and 10 n8n Node tests.

commands.command: RESEARCHFORGE_REASONING_MODE=deterministic docker compose build; docker compose up -d --wait; uv run python scripts/docker_smoke.py
commands.summary: Fresh V1.6 API/frontend images built, PostgreSQL/API/Web became healthy and three autonomous reviewed-cache Docker runs each exposed six Facts and a ten-stage Trace.
Packaged launcher imported/published researchforgeV16, passed Docker smoke and actual n8n 2.37.9 runtime across three autonomous cases, native form, replay and five HTTP failure checks.
Five actual transport-only n8n failure scenarios passed bounded routing without supplying financial truth.

next_action.title: Perform owner acceptance and freeze V1.6
next_action.why: Golden Regression and the complete local engineering gate are green; the remaining release requirement is the owner manually confirming the company-first product experience and accepting any documented non-blocking limitations.
next_action.first_step: Use the running Web product at http://127.0.0.1:4173/ for representative arbitrary-company research, open supporting Evidence and Trace, and confirm a failure/abstention state is understandable.
acceptance_evidence: Owner can submit a representative arbitrary-company request from the Web company-first entry.
At least one successful result exposes inspectable Facts, Evidence and a completed Research Trace.
At least one unsupported or failed request is clearly presented as no research result rather than plausible output.
Any final UI/prompt/product blocker is fixed; remaining limitations are explicitly accepted as non-blocking.
Only after owner acceptance is RELEASE_FREEZE marked completed.

last_session.summary: Completed the V1.6 engineering release candidate: hardened SEC/provider failures, passed quick and extended CN/US/HK Golden Regression, migrated Web/n8n/runtime checks to the autonomous API, passed all local non-container and container gates, and aligned active product/portfolio/release documentation. Owner acceptance remains before Release Freeze.
